work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CXCVIII 60494, synopsis 60496–60502 and episcopal Urbanus protocol 60504–60508 establish this separate indult. Entire preamble and sections 1–8 run in order: section 1 recounts prior Sixtus grants, section 4 grants the current extension, and section 5 continues across headers. Local notes 60544–60546, 60597–60598, 60648, 60819–60821 and 60871 remain attached to their markers; historical syntax cautions are retained, not rewritten. Full/short dating 60954–60957 and marginal continuation 60960 close before CXCIX 60963.
